messages:
Support Bot: forwarded customer request from acme-corp: 'Can you consolidate multiple support tickets into a single backlog item and show which customers are affected? We need regular updates to those requesters.' Link: https://support.redwood.ai/t/ACME-342

Jess R: received 6 similar tickets in the last 3 weeks, many from enterprise customers. Filing here so product can decide merge + priority.

Sara L: thanks Jess. quick triage Qs: is this strictly about support ticket consolidation -> backlog, or also about an in-console UI for tracking merged requests?

Jess R: mostly the intake/merge + auto-update to requesters. A few ask for a dashboard but that seems secondary.

Mike T: tech note: merging tickets into a canonical backlog item is just process / tooling. Building a UI to show provenance across customers is ~2-3 sprint effort (API + frontend).

Alex P: ACME is on Dedicated and is our Q4 expansion prospect. They'll push for higher priority if we can promise a timeline.

Sara L: proposed approach: 1) Create canonical backlog issue that aggregates tickets (low-effort triage). 2) Add tags: customer-request, enterprise-impact, duplicate-merge, needs-scope. 3) Notify each requester with a standardized message. 4) Scope any UI work as separate initiative (requires PM + eng estimate). Agree?

Mike T: agree. For step 1 we can automate ticket linking in Zendesk -> JIRA with a small script, estimate ~3 days to ship. UI will be a separate roadmap ask.

Jess R: draft standard message for requesters: "Thanks — we've consolidated your report into a single request we're evaluating. We'll update you once we have scope and an ETA. If you need priority acceleration, reply with your business impact." Can we send that now?

Sara L: send now. I'll create the canonical backlog item in Jira: RW-8273. Add the tags above and paste the ticket IDs + short notes.

Alex P: please also add ARR / account tier in the Jira description so PM/sales prioritization is obvious.

Sara L: done: RW-8273 created, tagged customer-request, enterprise-impact, duplicate-merge, needs-scope. Linked tickets: ACME-342, BETA-904, NOVA-110, KITE-77, SUMO-12, ORCA-58. Added ARR notes and sales owner @Alex P.

Mike T: initial engineering notes added to RW-8273: "Option A: automation-only (zendesk->jira link + webhook updates) — ~3d. Option B: small admin UI to show merged provenance — ~3 sprints. Impact: low infra risk"

Jess R: I've sent the standardized message to all requesters and CC'd Alex where applicable. Copy of message: "We've consolidated your request into RW-8273. We're evaluating scope and will follow up with an ETA. Reply with business impact if you need higher priority."

Alex P: received from ACME; they asked if we can fast-track automation-only fix and add them to an early access list for the UI when prioritized. I'll log that in the account notes.

Sara L: next steps: - Mark RW-8273 as "triage: needs-scope" - PM to gather impact statements from sales (Alex) - Eng to scope automation spike (Mike) - Decide by next Wed whether to schedule automation in sprint or defer. I'll add a calendar check-in.

Mike T: I'll do the 3-day spike this week and drop findings in RW-8273. If trivial, we can ship as a patch in next sprint.

Jess R: thanks team. Please mark customer notification sent in the Jira when done.

Sara L: updated RW-8273 status to triage and added the follow-up meeting (Thu 10:00 PT). I'll update this thread after the spike. :calendar:

Support Bot: automated note: ticket linking automation created by Mike T is now assigned as subtask RW-8273-1 (est. 3d).

Sara L: follow-up: spike complete. Mike, can you summarize effort + acceptance criteria here so I can close triage?

Mike T: summary: automation-only solution does the following: 1) when support tags a set of tickets as "merge-canonical", a webhook consolidates them into RW-8273 and creates links in each ticket. 2) webhook triggers an outbound message to requesters with the template Jess suggested. 3) logs provenance in Jira issue comments. Effort: 3 dev days, 1 QA day. Acceptance criteria: automation runs on test org, links tickets, sends notifications, and logs provenance. No UI changes.

Sara L: perfect. marking RW-8273 "ready for scheduling" and recommending schedule in next sprint. I'll ping sales for final prioritization.

Alex P: ACME verbally confirmed they'll accept automation-only for now. marking as sales-OK.

Jess R: closing loop — requesters have been updated, thread can be archived after RW-8273 moves into sprint. :white_check_mark:
